Discover Xiaomi
Shaping the future together
We were founded in April 2010 as a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an IoT platform at its core.
Our mission
Build amazing products with honest prices to let everyone in the world enjoy a better life through innovative technology.
Our vision
Make friends with users and be the coolest company in the users’ hearts.
Our strategy
At Xiaomi, we believe technology’s the true power lies in its ability to understand and enhance the human experience. This year, with the upgraded Xiaomi HyperOS 2 and the newly launched Xiaomi HyperAI, we are redefining connection. Our「Human x Car x Home」smart ecosystem has evolved into a realm of connected intelligence. Your devices, your home, and your car no longer simply interact — they collaborate and adapt to your needs, attuning themselves to you with an unprecedented level of insight and understanding. It's not just about integration. It's about technology that learns from you, anticipates your needs, and evolves to create a more intuitive, responsive, and personal experience. This is no longer a vision of tomorrow. It's the reality of a smarter, more interconnected world today.
Our commitment
We are committed to building a sustainable world —designing responsibly and producing sustainably.
Optimize use of sustainable materials
Simplify the manufacturing line
Set up greener logistics
By 2040, Xiaomi will achieve carbon neutrality 100% renewable energy utilization in the operation of our existing business.
View more
Join Xiaomi
This is where curious minds gather
We firmly believe that talent is the cornerstone of high-quality technological innovation, and we consistently maintain a leading position in talent development amidst intense industry competition. Our impact is globally recognized: We’ve been featured in TIME's list of the 100 Most Influential Companies and named to the Fortune Global 500 six times.* Join us at Xiaomi and collaborate with exceptional talents worldwide to pioneer the intelligent future together!
